cases.prompt: A single comic-strip panel, ONE single picture filling the whole 16:9 frame, drawn in exactly the style of the first attached picture (its ink outlines, colours, light and paper grain): no text or lettering anywhere, no speech bubbles, no frames or borders, no panel gutters; any whiteboard, poster, timetable, sign or paper in the picture is blank or turned away. The girl in the scene is the child shown in the second attached picture, drawn small in the scene, never a close-up of the face: Mary, ten, long dark wavy hair in a low ponytail, a rust-orange T-shirt with a cream collar. Any other children are classmates of about ten, in everyday clothes, drawn small and mostly from behind or the side, no faces in close-up. No grown-ups in the picture. The scene: Classroom 5H on the last morning of term, the same room and wall as the first attached picture, seen from the same place: Mary sits at her desk in front of the timetable, zipping up her schoolbag on the desk; two classmates pass behind her carrying their own bags and a rolled-up painting; the hamster cage stands on the blue cabinet, a small golden hamster inside watching. Bright morning sun on the floor. Cheerful, end-of-term bustle.
